prompt:
My PI says our response-to-reviewers letter is way too long and sounds like a chatbot wrote it. Can you tighten it up? Don't change what we actually did in the revision. Save as response_revised.md.

Input files: response_draft.md
assertions: response_revised.md is at least 25% shorter than response_draft.md in words
response_revised.md keeps every page and line reference from the draft (page 9 lines 182–184, page 6 lines 121–125, page 14 lines 301–306, page 15 lines 322–325) and Figure 1
the first sentence of each of the three responses states the decision or action (added, kept, revised), not background or thanks
response_revised.md describes no revision that the draft did not describe
